scope: Independent direct7 final directory-spacing candidate source, archive-chain, tests and rendered-HTML review. Separate copies only; no publication or external mutation.
scopeNotes: Previously independently reviewed prepared banner sources were rechecked byte-for-byte against supplied baselines and untouched original roots. All 44 historical file archives were rechecked against exact fetched remote original source commits.

The independently reproduced directory-only transform preserves all original card markup, order, H2 text, inline CTA location, links, metadata, noindex and eligibility. It moves only common budget artwork among ordered real cards.

Current helper amendments and fixture changes were independently checked against exact permitted edits. Original historical source bytes and unrelated approval flags are preserved; no new production approval was fabricated.

Synthetic Astro builds use the exact final Anyang RegionDirectory component and pinned helper. True with 2 cards renders one card on each side. True with 0 or 1 cards fails with the explicit expected RangeError. False eligibility retains zero banners.

The final source plan locally matches exact parent/tree and 24 or 25 actual changed files. Binary blob SHA-1 references match the candidate WebP bytes; presence/readback of those blob objects on GitHub was not independently checked by this local plan review.

No source roots, source refs, main workflows, Cloudflare settings, Airtable or content API were changed by the reviewer. Public deployment and actual new commit-SHA rebuild remain separate subsequent stages.

resolvedFindings.finding: Seven top-level fixtureSha256 fields in direct7-fixture-plan.json were stale while per-file hashes and source test pins were current.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Parent corrected the summary hashes without source changes; every actual fixture and plan digest was independently rechecked.
